description: Sprint 05 Phase 2 policy-as-code pack. Encodes the mandatory release controls from ADR-0010 (policy-as-code and release evidence gates) and ADR-0011 (cantonal legal applicability gate) as machine-checkable rules.

mandatoryControls.name: PHI residency and transfer guardrails
mandatoryControls.description: Every deployment environment must pin resources to an approved Swiss region so PHI does not leave Switzerland.

mandatoryControls.name: Prohibited deployment-type restrictions
mandatoryControls.description: No environment may select a prohibited (global or data-zone) deployment type for PHI-bearing workloads.

mandatoryControls.name: Mandatory identity controls
mandatoryControls.description: Managed-identity controls must be enabled for affected resources.

mandatoryControls.name: Mandatory diagnostics controls
mandatoryControls.description: Diagnostics / observability must be enabled for affected resources.

mandatoryControls.name: Cantonal legal applicability annex completeness
mandatoryControls.description: Every canton entry in the annex must carry the ADR-0011 mandatory fields, an assigned owner, and a valid status; expired annex exceptions block PROD promotion.
